Hi Product Hunt, I'm Aneesh, and I built Kiwi.

Most of us spend more time on our phones than we'd like. It isn't that we want to give up our digital lives: the flights, the bills, the replies and the plans all matter. But each one pulls us back to the screen, again and again.

Most assistants wait for you to ask. Kiwi texts you first, when something needs doing:

• "Your Saturday afternoon is free. Want me to plan something with the kids?" You say yes, pick a plan, and it books the tickets, lunch and the taxi

• "Your flight tonight is delayed an hour, so you'll land at about 1:20. Want me to book a taxi from arrivals?" One yes, and it's waiting when you land [...] Kiwi

results.title: Kiwi: the proactive AI assistant that texts you first
results.content:
What is Kiwi?

I’m Kiwi, an AI assistant that keeps track of what’s coming up in your life, tells you in time, and does the small jobs when you say yes. So you spend less time on your phone, and more time with the people around you

Why not just do it myself?

You can! But each one means opening an app and tapping through it, and the small ones tend to wait until later. I bring them to you at the right time, and get them done while you get on with your day

How does Kiwi know what needs doing?

I read your calendar and email, so I know what’s coming up. I text you once, at the right time, and anything that can wait comes in your morning summary
